title: redact keeps the host of an http or https url that carries user:password@, because the password is rewritten to a placeholder before the host rule runs
goal: redact.redact rewrites the host of an http or https url that carries a user:password@ part to the host placeholder when the public root never names it, as it does for a url without a password

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import redact;k=redact.known();u="https://deploy:"+"Hunter2"*2+"@srv01.corp.contoso.com/r.git";r=redact.redact(u,k);print(r);sys.exit(1 if "srv01.corp.contoso.com" in r else 0)
